messages:
Mei Chen: Quick heads-up — proposing a gated Dedicated deploy for Hightide Health (customer org) on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Plan: canary slice -> 10% traffic for 10m -> 50% -> 100%. Pin runtime to inference-server v2.3.1-quant and model to redwood-falcon-7b.q8.
Omar Vasquez: +1 on time window, aligns with their low-traffic window. Are we good on KMS rotation overlap?
Tara (CustSuccess): Confirmed with Hightide — they approved the 02:00 UTC window and will have an ops person on call. They asked for a short rollback notice if issues.
Mei Chen: KMS: Security requested no key rotation within 24h of cutover. Security-Bot, can you confirm current rotation schedule?
Security-Bot: KMS rotation check: next scheduled rotation for hth-kms is 2026-04-03T07:00:00Z. No conflicts.
SRE-Oncall: Can we add a safety latch: auto-fallback to redwood-falcon-7b.fp16 across slices if token latency p95 > 650ms for 3m or error rate > 1.5%? Also need a manual rollback playbook attached.
Mei Chen: Yes to both. Adding thresholds to rollout policy and will attach playbook. Manual rollback steps (brief):
```
# rollback playbook extract
1) deploybot rollback --org hightide --slice canary --to-version v2.2.9
2) route traffic back to previous model variant
3) alert CS and run quick-evals on 5 golden prompts
```
Liam Nguyen: Deploybot, can you schedule the canary and post a dry-run plan? Tagging @SRE-Oncall for alert hooks.
deploybot: scheduled canary for 3176543210 at 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Dry-run window: 2026-04-01T23:00:00Z. Rollout policy: canary 10% (10m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (30m). Safety-latch: auto-fallback to fp16 if latency/errors breach thresholds.
Omar Vasquez: Note: pin runtime v2.3.1-quant has known slower cold-start for long contexts; recommend prewarmed instances for canary slices. Ops: please allocate 2 prewarmed pods.
SRE-Oncall: Allocated 2 prewarmed pods in dedicated pool. Will monitor KV-cache warmup.
Tara (CustSuccess): Customer requested release notes bullet about slight perf tradeoff with quantization but lower cost. I'll draft and send to them after merge.
Mei Chen: Draft release notes snippet: "Serving runtime pinned to v2.3.1-quant for Hightide Health. Improves token throughput and cost; may show higher cold-start for >4k tokens. Auto-fallback policy in place." Approve?
Liam Nguyen: LGTM. Also adding a post-deploy smoke checklist: 1) sanity queries 2) embed-quality check 3) latency sweep traces. I'll post the checklist in the canary thread.
Omar Vasquez: One more ask — add metric regression alert for output-quality drift: if BLEU-ish similarity on golden prompts drops >6% in canary vs baseline, auto-pause rollout.
Mei Chen: Added. Final ask: Security-Bot confirm TLS cert rotation and HSM key ACLs for the dedicated pool?
Security-Bot: TLS cert valid until 2027-01-12. HSM ACLs: customer HSM binding present, no recent ACL changes. All green.
Tara (CustSuccess): Customer ops contact: emma.li@hightide.example (on-call during window). They requested 30m notice before final 100% traffic switch.
Mei Chen: Noted — we'll send a 30m pre-switch. Deploybot, include an automated 30-minute pre-switch notification to customer contact and CS.
deploybot: notification action added: pre-switch @ 30m -> email to emma.li@hightide.example and Slack DM to Tara.
Liam Nguyen: I'll be monitoring traces during rollout. SRE-Oncall will handle infra alerts. Anyone object to go-ahead?
Omar Vasquez: No objections.
SRE-Oncall: No objections.
Security-Bot: No objections.
Mei Chen: Ok locking schedule. I'll attach the final rollout note (link) and push pin to release config: runtime=v2.3.1-quant, model=redwood-falcon-7b.q8, rollout=canary->50->100, safety-latch settings.
Tara (CustSuccess): Thanks team. I'll confirm customer contact details and expect the 30m heads-up on deploy day. :thumbsup:
